alerts.text: Fable 5 & Claude Code limits extended to Jul 19
alerts.dashboardText: Anthropic extended Fable 5's promotional access — up to 50% of your weekly usage limit on Pro, Max, Team, and select Enterprise plans — and is keeping Claude Code's weekly rate limits 50% higher, both through July 19, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM PT. Tap for details.
